components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one filled action (Watchntalk's Open on the web).
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 18px; border-radius: 12px; background: #1d1d1f; color: #fff; text-decoration: none; font: 640 15px/1 'Mona Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; transition: transform .3s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), background-color .2s; } .ds-btn:hover { background: #000; transform: translateY(-1px); }

components.name: Arrow Link
components.description: Secondary actions in a product band, in the app's ink.
components.html: Nasıl kullanılır
components.css: .ds-arrow { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; min-height: 44px; color: #b4470b; font: 620 16px/1 'Mona Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; } .ds-arrow svg { transition: transform .3s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-arrow:hover svg { transform: translateX(3px); }

components.name: Language Switch
components.description: TR/EN segmented control on every page.
components.css: .ds-lang { display: inline-flex; padding: 3px; border-radius: 10px; background: #f5f5f7; } .ds-lang button { appearance: none; min-width: 40px; min-height: 34px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; color: #6a6a6f; font: 650 13px/1 'Mona Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-lang button[aria-pressed=true] { background: #fff; color: #1d1d1f; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.12), 0 2px 6px -2px rgba(0,0,0,.12); }

components.name: Status Mark
components.description: Live (filled), in review (half), web-only (outline); always with a text label.
components.css: .ds-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; color: #424245; font: 600 14px/1.2 'Mona Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-status::before { content: ''; width: 9px; height: 9px; border-radius: 2px; background: #f26b1d; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1.5px #b4470b; }

narrative.northStar: The shelf the apps stand on
narrative.overview: A white, well-lit page in the manner of Panic, Lux and Cultured Code: confident type, generous space, and the apps speaking through their real icons and screenshots. The hub owns no colour; each app brings its own. App pages share the stylesheet, so the hub and every policy page read as one site.
keyCharacteristics: Real icons, screenshots and the official App Store badge
Turkish and English on every page
Policy text carried over word for word

rules.name: The Borrowed Colour Rule
rules.body: The hub has no brand colour; colour appears only inside an app's region, taken from its icon.

rules.name: The Ink-for-Text Rule
rules.body: Vivid app colours never carry text; links and taglines use the app's ink value.

dos: Keep every App Store Connect URL; restyle in place
Carry policy text word for word with its last-updated line
Write in first person and say where an app stops
donts: No hub colour or gradient headline
No version numbers on the hub; update review states when they change
Don't touch /puzzlelens/review/ or the root app-ads.txt
